name: Distressed Moto Jacket
description: Hand-abraded heavy steerhide with artisanal oil wash. Asymmetric gunmetal hardware and drop-shoulder boxy cut engineered for dramatic silhouette. Each piece carries unique distressing and patina.
material: 100% full-grain distressed cowhide leather. 100% Japanese cupro twill lining.
fitNotes: Cropped boxy cut with extended sleeves. Designed to sit at the natural waist. Size up for layering.

name: Heavy Fleece Hoodie 01
description: 600 GSM loopback French terry drenched in vintage mineral wash. Double-layered hood without drawstring for clean architectural drape. Raw edge ribbing with understated tonal embroidery.
material: 100% combed heavyweight cotton (600 GSM). Pre-shrunk with stone mineral wash.
fitNotes: Oversized, relaxed boxy cut. Drop shoulder with stacked sleeve volume.

name: Racing Spider Oversized Tee
description: 310 GSM combed cotton jersey featuring hand-pulled cracked discharge print. Enzyme washed for a decayed vintage drape that contours naturally. Reinforced rib collar with dropped armholes.
material: 100% high-density combed jersey (310 GSM). Cracked solvent ink screenprint.
fitNotes: Wide, relaxed oversized fit. Elongated sleeve length falling below the elbow.

name: Raw Plaster Hoodie 02
description: Heavyweight bone plaster terry treated with subtle wax resist and clay bath. Features raw-cut hems, exposed overlock stitching, and ergonomic thumbhole cuffs. Subdued chalk tone developed exclusively for this drop.
material: 100% custom dye-cast cotton fleece (580 GSM). Pigment hand-dyed.
fitNotes: Sculptural drop shoulder with cropped hem. Fits boxy through the chest.

name: Waxed Cargo Pants
description: Paraffin wax coated cotton canvas engineered with 8 modular flap pockets. Articulated knee darts and cinch hems allow transformation between straight and tapered silhouettes. Water-resistant matte finish.
material: 100% heavy cotton duck canvas with paraffin wax impregnation. Matte black snap hardware.
fitNotes: Relaxed straight leg with adjustable drawcord cuff. True to size at waist.

name: Acid Wash Denim Trucker
description: 14.5 oz Japanese selvedge denim subjected to harsh potassium acid treatment. Features distressed fraying on collar and cuffs with antiqued silver shank buttons. Unlined for raw drape.
material: 100% Kurabo Japanese denim (14.5 oz). Custom forged iron buttons.
fitNotes: Boxy trucker silhouette with lowered chest pockets. True to size.

name: Raw Hem Straight Jeans
description: Rigid black warp and ecru weft denim with frayed scissor-cut hems. Natural whisker fades and honeycombs created through manual stone scraping. Hidden selvedge coin pocket detail.
fitNotes: Classic straight leg with medium rise. Full break over footwear.

name: Heavy Sweatpants 01
description: 500 GSM thermal French terry cut in an aggressive stacked silhouette. Deep slash pockets with hidden zip security pouch. Thick elastic waistband with elongated bleached drawstrings.
material: 100% organic cotton French terry (500 GSM). Raw wash finish.
fitNotes: Loose through thigh with subtle taper and heavy stacking at the ankle.

name: Washed Boxy Tee 02
description: Minimalist heavyweight tee in asphalt wash with blind stitch hems. Seamless tubular construction prevents twisting. Subtle vertical spine seam detail along the back.
fitNotes: Square boxy fit with dropped shoulders and a higher, tighter neck collar.

name: Cracked Leather Biker Boots
description: Handcrafted Goodyear welted boots in cracked white-over-black calfskin. Thick commando lug sole with squared architectural toe. Antiqued side zip with custom brutalist pull tab.
material: Full-grain calfskin leather with cracked wax finish. Vibram commando lug outsole.
fitNotes: True to size. Fits comfortably with thick wool socks.

name: Distressed Knit Beanie
description: Chunky ribbed beanie spun from unbleached merino wool and brushed mohair. Finished with manual hand-fraying along the crown and foldover cuff. Breathable yet insulating.
fitNotes: One size fits all. Relaxed slouch or double-cuffed fitted wear.

name: Waxed Canvas Tote
description: Utilitarian oversized tote in 18 oz blackened waxed canvas. Features reinforced seatbelt webbing handles and interior padded sleeve accommodating up to 16" laptops. Solid brass hardware.
material: 18 oz water-repellent waxed canvas. Bridle leather trim.
fitNotes: Dimensions: 46cm W x 42cm H x 14cm D. 28cm handle drop.
